scoring_method: Import existing qualified native receipts and explicit AI semantic reviews. Score selected properties only; unknown weights remain unresolved. Not a final v2 benchmark grade.
limitations: Post-outcome rubric/subweights; existing instruction conditions remain separate.
Numeric bounds indicate unresolved evidence, not capability confidence intervals or rankings.
Passing a finite control family is not full-domain reference or grader qualification.
Unrequested v2 deliverables do not become historical model failures.
H2 paper-rubric and H3 hybrid-review interfaces retain their original task scope.
H4 controls corrected post-outcome; H6 excluded positives never regain gold status.
No additional defect-output count from duplicate failed dimensions/checks.
The prior verified ZIP is unchanged; this is a separate retrospective addendum.
